notes.title: 《幻想乡之玉》即将永久免费和服务器到期后数据重置的公告
notes.notes: [p]《幻想乡之玉》的主服务器即将在近期之内到期，我们不得不非常遗憾地告诉大家，我们无法继续维系主服务器的费用和游戏的运营，原有的服务器数据将因此无法得到保存。幸运地是，我们仍然有一个相对廉价的备用服务器，因此，我们决定在7月24日以后，在备用服务器继续运行游戏，并且将游戏改为完全永久免费，届时将关闭充值通道和通行证等内容，且会发放足够购买游戏内所有内容的月之石。如果还喜欢《幻想乡之玉》的玩家，之后可以尽情游玩游戏内的所有内容了。[/p][p]《幻想乡之玉》是我们的第一个项目，有很多不成熟不合理的地方，特别是在内购设置方面，给各位玩家带来了不那么好的体验，在此我们向大家深表歉意。我们将会吸取经验教训，在未来将更好的作品呈现给大家。[/p]

notes.title: The official launch announcement of "Gensokyo Orb"
notes.notes:
Dear Gensokyo Orb players, the long-awaited moment has finally arrived!

The Touhou Project strategy game, "Gensokyo Orb," is officially launching on August 29th at 12:00 PM! 🎉

We sincerely apologize for the delay. Due to some unexpected public events earlier this year, our game underwent an unusually stringent review process on the platform, which prevented us from launching as originally planned on July 25th. However, after our continuous efforts, the game has successfully passed the review process with only some minor adjustments to the cover art, and no other content changes were made!

The game will be available on Steam, and we will continuously optimize it and make improvements based on your feedback. This could include additional voice acting, other language versions, and more!

This is a project we've poured our heart and soul into, with over a year of meticulous development. We strive to achieve excellence in strategy, visuals, and overall gameplay experience, bringing you a world filled with deep strategy and the unique charm of Gensokyo.

As an online game with ongoing support, the game itself is free to play, with some in-app purchases available for certain items.

In "Gensokyo Orb," you'll lead the girls of Gensokyo on a journey to the pinnacle of strategy and tactics. With over 20 unique characters to choose from, each with their distinct features, the possibilities for strategic combinations are endless.

The game is packed with strategic challenges that will provide you with endless enjoyment! If you have any thoughts or suggestions during your playthrough, please feel free to discuss them in our community or player group! We are eagerly looking forward to hearing from you.

If you enjoy the game, don't forget to leave us a recommendation. It means the world to us!

Thank you all for your support! We wish you a delightful journey in Gensokyo!

notes.title: "Gensokyo Orb" Dreamy Test Server Opening Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3]亲爱的幻玉玩家：[/h3]
《幻想乡之玉》「绮梦测试」即将于2024年2月1日12:00正式开启！准备好带领少女们进行战斗了吗！

[h3]【注意事项】[/h3]
为了维护游戏的公平与秩序，严禁使用外挂、脚本等破坏游戏公平性的任何第三方工具，一经发现，制作组将采取包括但不限于：立即对违规账号进行永久封停、没收违规所得、重置账号数据等措施。

[h3]【意见与建议】[/h3]
大家在游玩过程中有任何意见或建议，或是bug反馈，欢迎通过以下方式进行告诉我们：
1.加入官方玩家交流群828882064、743660183
2.加入官方Kook群：https://kook.top/nLZASV 3.向客服信箱投稿：lotumn@qq.com


[h3]【详细更新内容】[/h3]
【功能调整】
█大厅UI：
·重新设计了任务界面。
·重新设计了通知界面。
·重新设计了设置界面。
	增加了自定义按键功能。
·*新增了【商店】功能。
·*新增了【仓库】功能。
·*新增了【邮件】功能。
·*新增了【回放】功能。
·*新增了【装扮】功能。

█战斗UI：
·重新设计了对话界面。
·重新设计了商店界面。
	将药品栏进行了独立分区。
·重新设计了战斗界面。
	现在施法区域分为： 法术&基础技能、符卡&消耗品、已完成的咏唱&其他衍生 三大类
	通过tag栏进行切换，类似商店界面。
·重新设计了发动技能、进行移动时的地图格指示表现，现在将更加醒目且美观。

█对战模式：
·幻境赛事：更名为幻境华牌祭
	现在仅提供临时解锁符卡，不再能够禁用角色
·*新增模式：极夜对决
	每晚19:00~次日4:00，匹配分数≥2000可以参加，每名玩家可以禁用2名角色。获得与失去的匹配分数为匹配模式的1.5倍，使用特殊地图池。

█冒险模式：
·主线剧情：更名为「幻想纪行」
	增加了全新的序章及第一章，由18个各具特色的关卡组成
·训练模式：更名为「道场训练」
	由7个训练关卡组成
·调整模式：更名为「须臾难题」
	由10个颇具挑战性的关卡组成

【游戏调整】
█弹幕球抽取：
·现在使用“冷却球”机制，即：
当1枚弹幕球被抽取出后，该弹幕球不参与接下来的5次抽取。

█使用技能方式：
	现在可以直接通过点击技能条来发动技能，将自动消耗对应元素。
	当欲发动的技能元素需求较为复杂时，第一次点击技能条后，可以通过鼠标滚轮或“Z”及“X”键来选择欲消耗的元素组合。再次点击技能条则消耗所选择的元素发动技能。

notes.title: "The 'Fantasy Dream Test' for 'Gensokyo Orb' will commence on February 1st
notes.notes:
Dear Gensokyo Orb Players,

The "Fantasy Dream Test" for "Gensokyo Orb" is set to officially launch on February 1, 2024, at 12:00! This "Phantom Test" features brand-new artistic expressions, a multitude of new content and gameplay mechanics, all awaiting players to explore. The production team looks forward to bringing everyone together for an unparalleled and exciting fantasy feast.

Test Duration
This test, which includes a fee and character data deletion, is tentatively scheduled from 12:00 on February 1, 2024, to 23:59 on February 15, 2024.

Test Content

Added new functionalities such as "Replay," "Shop," "Warehouse," and "Mail."
Added over 30 new PVE mainline stages as well as challenge levels, and introduced over 30 different types of enemy units.
An entirely new battle UI design, including redesigned areas for the common shop, spellcasting, and map grid indications when unleashing skills.
Redesigned the "Settings," "Notifications," and "Missions" interfaces.
Optimized bullet sphere drawing and implemented a "Cooling Orb Mechanism" to almost completely prevent extreme situations.
Added a new feature that allows skills to be activated directly by clicking on the skill bar, which will automatically consume the corresponding elements.
Introduced over 10 new types of neutral creatures that will appear in PVP maps.
Please Note
The game is still in the process of polishing, and this test does not represent the quality of the final product. During the testing period, if players encounter any problems or have suggestions, you are welcome to provide feedback. The production team will continue to optimize the game content and improve game quality based on your feedback, aiming to create a better experience for all Gensokyo Orb enthusiasts.

Feedback Methods:

Join the official player communication group at 828882064.
Join the official Kook group: https://kook.top/nLZASV
Submit to customer service mailbox: lotumn@qq.com
Tri Eye Production Team

notes.title: The first test of "Gensokyo Orb" will start on March 31!
notes.notes:
Dear all Gensokyo Orb players:
       With the "Gensokyo Orb" steam store page online. We have been working harder and harder to reunite with you soon. Now, we are pleased to announce to you: "Gensokyo Orb" "the first test" will be officially opened on March 31!

[Test time]
       This test is in the form of deletion, the total time of the test is to be determined.

[Test content]
       This test will add open match mode, teaching level and single player challenge level for everyone to play.

      This test will add 4 new characters (22 in total), 3 new maps (6 in total) and a public store system to the matchmaking mode.

      In this test, players can earn Gensokyo Orb currency by leveling up, playing matchmaking, and solo challenge levels, which is used to unlock more spell cards for characters.

      During the test, more characters, battle maps and single-player challenge levels will be updated to provide a richer experience.

[Note]
     1. In order to maintain the fairness and order of the game, it is strictly forbidden to use any third-party tools such as hangers, scripts, etc. that destroy the fairness of the game, once found, we will take measures including but not limited to: immediate permanent suspension of the offending account, confiscation of illegal income, etc.

     2. If you find any bugs in the game, welcome to give feedback in the steam community or official QQ group (828882064), we will be grateful.

    The game is still in the state of continuous polishing, this test does not represent the final online quality, welcome players to put forward valuable comments and suggestions, the production team is looking forward to working with all players, and constantly create a better Gensokyo Orb.

Tri eye production team
